WORK-CLASS / 800 M

R-400

Twelve thrusters for work in open water.

A 520 kg work-class ROV rated to 800 m, with a 50 kg payload and 12 thrusters for offshore wind foundations, subsea cables and hydropower tasks.

COMPLETE SYSTEM

Specify more than
the vehicle.

Sonar and five- or seven-function manipulators are optional items purchased separately. The manufacturer describes modest support-vessel requirements; confirm the vessel, launch system and complete-system footprint for each project. The two brochure versions differ on camera count (four or five directions).

Confirm in the delivered scope

  • Vehicle and installed payload
  • Control station and software functions
  • Tether length, reel and power supply
  • Selected tools, sensors and deployment equipment
  • Transport cases, spares, manuals and training

Standard, optional and custom items must be listed separately in the quotation.

QUESTIONS

Before you specify the R-400.

How does the R-400 compare with the R-150?

The R-400 is rated deeper (800 m vs 500 m), carries more payload (50 kg vs 20 kg) and has 12 thrusters instead of 8. It is also heavier and needs larger launch equipment, so choose it when the task needs the extra depth, tooling or thrust.

Has it been used offshore?

The manufacturer reports two offshore wind projects in Guangdong, China, for an offshore wind farm operator: inspection of booster-station pile foundations and grouting, and a subsea cable survey covering seabed anomalies and burial depth. These are manufacturer references, not projects delivered by PanPan Marine.
